title: feat: show community model uptime in Play
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds one 24-hour health dot beside community models in Play.
- Reuses the existing model-status endpoint and its 60-second cache.
- Uses the same 2xx/5xx health thresholds as the model monitor.
- Keeps official models unchanged and adds no backend surface.
- Simplified during review from 195 to 120 lines and corrected video models to use their generate.image health rows.

Fixes #13153

gist.headline: A tiny dot tells tales
gist.blurb: Community models in Play now carry a small 24-hour health signal beside their names. Polli has checked the weather before sending you into the garden.
gist.summary: Play now shows a 24-hour uptime dot beside community models, using the existing cached model-status endpoint and the monitor’s 2xx/5xx health thresholds, including generate.image rows for video models.
gist.impact: Users can quickly spot the recent health of a community model before choosing it in Play, while official model listings remain unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-selection garden where community model cards are little seed packets or flower pots, each with a clear green health dot. Polli, wearing a tiny inspector cap and holding a clipboard, checks the dots while a friendly CRT monitor robot displays a simple 24-hour status strip; healthy code-plants and flowers make the status check feel reassuring rather than clinical.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny inspector cap, checking glowing 24-hour health dots beside little community-model seed packets in a garden-like retro computer interface; a friendly CRT monitor robot shows a simple row of green status pixels. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-plants and flowers, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with small pixel-font text: "24H UP".
